S2.headline: Sale lost on a transient error
S2.patchNote: Claude's edits match lib/store/naive.ts exactly. Self-corrected after 1 check.
S2.fixSummary: Send the capture with a stable PayPal-Request-Id and retry a transient 5xx with backoff, reusing the same id so PayPal cannot capture twice. Only a final failure is recorded as FAILED.

S3.headline: Buyer charged twice
S3.fixSummary: When the capture outcome is unknown (timeout or no usable answer), ask PayPal for the order with getOrder and use reconciliationFrom to take the real status and capture id. Report FAILED only if PayPal also shows no capture.

S4.headline: Order shipped twice
S4.fixSummary: Claim the event id and apply its effect atomically with applyEventOnce, and return outcome duplicate when the event was already processed. The primary key on event_id then stops a replay from fulfilling again, even under concurrent deliveries.

S5.headline: Refunded order shown as paid
S5.fixSummary: On each relevant event, fetch the order from PayPal and derive the status with statusFromPayPal. Apply it through applyEventOnce, which claims the event id so replays are ignored and fulfilment is recorded once. If PayPal cannot be reached, return 503 so PayPal redelivers the event.

S6.headline: Forged refund accepted
S6.fixSummary: Verify the delivery with verifyWebhookSignature before touching the order. Reject missing headers or a failed check with a 400, and return a 503 when verification is unavailable so PayPal retries.
